verdict.rationale: dlt documents a custom-destination interface for building reverse ETL pipelines, and it can read modeled warehouse tables through its SQL database source (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or `pipeline.dataset()`. However, the evidence shows no prebuilt CRM, ads or support destinations, so the engineer must hand-code each sync to a SaaS tool. Missing for 10: ready-made SaaS activation destinations (CRM, ads, support), field-mapping and sync-mode documentation for pushing to SaaS APIs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of reverse ETL use.
